 dsm-firmenich launches Sustell™ Carbon Value Program to drive progress towards agri-food sustainability targets
 

 The Sustell™ Carbon Value Program covers the full set of requirements to reduce carbon footprints while providing a financial upside

 

 
 
 
 
 3 December 2025
 
 

 
 
 
 1 minute read
 
 

 
 
 
 By: Laurence Williams 
 

 

 
 
 

 

 

 

 dsm-firmenich Animal Nutrition & Health today announced the launch of its Sustell™ Carbon Value Program, a breakthrough solution designed to help the agri-food value chain reduce carbon footprints at low cost – or even at a profit. This program enables companies to decarbonize their value chains, meet sustainability targets, comply with reporting requirements, and benefit financially from the achieved emissions reductions.

“Sustainability is about smarter production — getting more from less, cutting waste, and building stronger, more efficient farms and food systems,” said Dr. Heinz Flatnitzer, Global Head of Emissions Value Management at dsm-firmenich Animal Nutrition & Health.

“With the Sustell™ Carbon Value Program we help our clients scale carbon reductions with transparency, credibility, and measurable returns. By fostering farm-to-fork collaboration, partners across the value chain can achieve verified emission footprints with full traceability and additional financial value. We invite more companies to join us on this profitable journey toward a more sustainable food system.”

Why it matters

Agrifood, retailer, CPGs, and food service companies need to cut greenhouse gas emissions to meet sustainability targets that are driven by commitments, science-based targets, or customer demands. To achieve lower emissions, full value chain collaboration is required.

Farming accounts for a large proportion of the environmental footprint of food and beverage products. Innovative and scientifically proven animal nutrition solutions offer an off-the-shelf method to improve farm efficiency, profitabili and sustainability.

“On-farm nutritional interventions offer a turn-key way to improve farming income while reducing the Scope 3 environmental emissions of downstream companies in a cost-effective manner,” explained Dr. Flatnitzer. 

The program package

The Sustell™ Carbon Value Program covers the full set of requirements to reduce carbon footprints while providing a financial upside. The program package includes:

·      ISO-assured footprint measurement via the Sustell™ life cycle assessment platform.

·      The prerequisite protocols to credibly transfer emission reductions across the value chain.

·      Expertise on animal nutrition and sustainability to deliver impact from farm to fork.

As part of the effort, dsm-firmenich Animal Nutrition & Health has initiated pilot projects with various players in the agri-food industry, connecting retailers to producers and feed millers. The pilots are aimed to demonstrate the scalability and positive business value for all value chain players of sustainability transformation.

translationZh:
帝斯曼-芬美意动物营养与健康部门今日宣布推出其Sustell™碳价值计划，这是一项突破性解决方案，旨在帮助农业食品价值链以低成本——甚至盈利的方式——减少碳足迹。该计划使企业能够实现价值链脱碳、满足可持续发展目标、遵守报告要求，并从实现的减排中获得经济收益。

“可持续发展关乎更智能的生产——用更少的资源获得更多产出，减少浪费，并建设更强大、更高效的农场和食品系统，”帝斯曼-芬美意动物营养与健康部门排放价值管理全球负责人Heinz Flatnitzer博士表示。

“通过Sustell™碳价值计划，我们帮助客户以透明、可信且可衡量的回报来扩大碳减排规模。通过促进从农场到餐桌的合作，价值链上的合作伙伴能够实现经过验证的排放足迹，并具备完全可追溯性和额外的财务价值。我们邀请更多公司加入我们，共同踏上这条通往更可持续食品系统的盈利之旅。”

**为何重要**

农业食品、零售商、消费品公司和餐饮服务企业需要减少温室气体排放，以满足由承诺、科学碳目标或客户需求驱动的可持续发展目标。要实现更低的排放，需要整个价值链的协作。

养殖业在食品和饮料产品的环境足迹中占据很大比例。创新且经过科学验证的动物营养解决方案提供了一种现成的方法，可以提高农场效率、盈利能力和可持续性。

“农场层面的营养干预提供了一种现成的方式，可以提高养殖收入，同时以成本有效的方式减少下游企业的范围三环境排放，”Flatnitzer博士解释道。

**计划内容**

Sustell™碳价值计划涵盖了减少碳足迹的全部要求，同时提供财务收益。该计划包包括：

· 通过Sustell™生命周期评估平台进行ISO认证的足迹测量。

· 用于在价值链中可信地转移减排量的先决条件协议。

· 动物营养和可持续发展方面的专业知识，以实现从农场到餐桌的影响。

作为该计划的一部分，帝斯曼-芬美意动物营养与健康部门已与农业食品行业的多个参与者启动了试点项目，将零售商与生产商和饲料厂连接起来。这些试点旨在展示可持续转型对所有价值链参与者的可扩展性和积极商业价值。
